summary: Watch delivery failures retain unseen items and become strict-mode errors after one bounded retry.
reason: A failed receiver must not permanently consume alerts, and an empty recipient selection must be visible.
markers: no matching webhook succeeded (no matching hooks or delivery failed)
matching webhook(s) failed after retry; items retained
reapply: Retry each failed hook once with context-aware short backoff; require at least one successful matching hook. On build or delivery failure set anyFailed and skip MarkSeen; propagate failures under --strict. Any matching hook failure is fatal to that watch even when another hook succeeded.
